dedupe_keys.name: integriertes simulationsmodell zur anlageneinsatz und ausbauplanung mit regionalisierung isaar

description: Integriertes Simulationsmodell zur Anlageneinsatz- und -ausbauplanung mit Regionalisierung (ISAaR) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Forschungsstelle für Energiewirtschaft (FfE); München. covers the conventional power plant fleet, energy generation from renewable energies depending on the respective generation potentials, consumption loads of the end energy sectors as well as the transmission grid for 28 European countries. Coverage: Europe. Methodical focus: Sector Coupling. Time resolution: annual, hour. Spatial resolution: national states, regions, power stations. Software: MATLAB, PostgreSQL. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
